simple.meaning: שָׁרָב (shârâb) is a Hebrew word meaning “quivering glow (of the air), especially the mirage.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.

definitions.short: quivering glow (of the air), especially the mirage
definitions.full: H8273. sharab שָׁרָב noun masculine 1 burning heat ; 2 parched ground ; — only absolute: שׁ כֵּם יַ ׳וְלֹא וָשָׁ֑מֶשׁ Isa 49:10 ; of ground, ׳הַשּׁ 35:7 (|| צִמָּאוֺן ).
